newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 11.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Constitutional amendment talks between Nationalist and Democratic Progressive parties break down
Top Chinese leaders, including President Jiang Zemin, may attend handover ceremony in Hong Kong
UNITED DAILY NEWS - U.S. diplomat acknowledges revisions of U.S.-Japan security alliance target China
New Party asks Nationalist Party to postpone amendment of constitution
LIBERTY TIMES - China Airlines foundation to reelect board chairman
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Finance ministry on alert over deficits in two cooperatives in Kaohsiung
Over 40 percent of Japanese firms in Taiwan may strengthen their Taiwan bases after July 1 handover of Hong Kong to China
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Central bank to investigate marked differences in deposit and lending interest rates
Economics ministry to transfer some T$40 billion worth of high tech company shares to cabinet's Development Fund
